generation_sequence: TASK-001 was generated once as the infrastructure smoke test.
The first full batch invocation skipped the existing TASK-001 result and generated TASK-002 through TASK-015.
After all 15 task result files existed, two additional batch invocations were made without --overwrite.
Both later invocations skipped all existing task results and therefore made no model calls for those tasks.
The later no-op invocations overwrote run-manifest.json but did not overwrite any task-001.json through task-015.json result.
manifest_provenance_note: The original first-batch run-manifest.json was overwritten by later no-op batch invocations. The authoritative experimental observations are the 15 task-*.json files. run-manifest-noop-after-results.json preserves a no-op manifest for transparency.
